user.title: Meshroute Topology Explorer
user.description: Adds a read-only map of your Zigbee network to the sidebar. Nothing needs to be configured.

init.title: Meshroute Topology Explorer Options
init.description: Changes take effect when you save; Home Assistant itself is not restarted.

data_description.sidebar: Off removes the panel from the sidebar and from the address /meshroute-topology.
data_description.radio_actions: Off hides the scan button and the attribute read in the panel. It is a switch of this panel, not a lock: ZHA's own pages still offer both.

history.name: Reception history
history.description: Records the reception values of the neighbour tables that ZHA and the Matter server already hold, after each of ZHA's own topology scans. It never starts a scan.

data.scan_after_start: Scan once 30 minutes after Home Assistant starts

data_description.delete_history: Deletes all records when you save. Not kept as a setting.
data_description.scan_after_start: Asks ZHA for one topology scan, once per start, if radio actions are allowed, no scan is running and the last Zigbee record is older than ZHA's period. It is ZHA's own scan (radio traffic); the result is recorded like any other.

zha.name: ZHA topology scan
zha.description: {zha_scan}. The period is set in ZHA's configuration.yaml, which this integration never changes: a new value shows a snippet to paste, and needs a restart of Home Assistant Core.

data.confirm_short: Scan more often than every {recommended} minutes anyway

data_description.confirm_short: Only needed for a period under {recommended} minutes.

snippet.title: Set ZHA's scan period
snippet.description:
Paste this into configuration.yaml (merge it with an existing `zha:` block), then restart Home Assistant Core. Nothing has been changed in ZHA yet; after the restart the integration compares what ZHA reports.

```yaml
{snippet}
```

error.zha_range: The scan period must be {zha_range} minutes.
error.zha_short: A scan every {minutes} minutes: every scan asks each router for its tables, so a short period means more radio traffic in the whole network, and the history gets more records only if their values change. Tick the box to use {minutes} minutes anyway.
